name: TwinMind
description:
TwinMind is your AI meeting memory. It automatically captures and transcribes your meetings, then makes everything searchable and retrievable directly from Claude.

With the TwinMind connector, Claude can:

Search your meeting notes and summaries — ask "What did we decide about the Q4 launch?" and get answers grounded in your actual conversations
Retrieve tasks and action items — surface what was assigned to you across all your meetings
Pull full meeting context — fetch complete summaries and transcripts so Claude can draft follow-ups, recap decisions, or prepare you for your next call

Unlike reactive AI tools, TwinMind builds a persistent memory of your work conversations, so Claude always has the context of what was said, decided, and promised — without you re-explaining anything.

Works with your existing TwinMind account.

_published_faq.name: How do I add TwinMind to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add TwinMind to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.twinmind.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the TwinMind MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: TwinMind provides these MCP tools: fetch, search, summary_search, and todo_search.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to TwinMind?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to TwinMind in communication on the Manufact MCP catalog include AgentLine: Phone Numbers for AI Agents, JooVoice, OpenMail, Granola, and Fleet Connected Apps.
TwinMind requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
TwinMind is developed by TwinMind. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
